name: Cloudy Creek via the Mango Tree
description:
Sunday, September 17
Cloudy Creek via the Mango Tree

Leader: Wilfred Karnoll
Rated: moderately hard. for bushwalkers comfortable with rock hopping. Off-track walk

Description:
Starting at the car park we walk up the intake road and drop into the creek where it crosses under the road. From there its rock hopping in the creek bed some rock scrambling and some bush bashing all the way to where the Cloudy creek track comes down from the village.
We have to have an early start to have some vehicles waiting in Paluma for the return trip to the bottom.
Meeting point Details will be emailed out prior to the walk. Probably a 7:00 am meeting at Paluma to organise car shuttles. Expect a 7 hr day.  

RSVP: Please contact Wilfred directly to let him know you are coming! 
Must be over 18 years to participate or approved by the committee.  
Fee: Non-member/visitors- $5. TBWC Club members - Free. You can become a TBWC member after 3 walks as a visitor. 

If you have not walked with us before, please contact the walk leader before RSVP registration.
For more information, please contact us.
